I corrected the ensemble statements to use periodized empirical fields. Georgii’s results concern those spatially averaged fields, which avoids claiming that a raw free-box law at a fixed origin is stationary. [Georgii’s paper](https://www.mathematik.uni-muenchen.de/~georgii/papers/LDPsuperstable.pdf)

The beta-zero item proves the pressure rates and minimizer set; it does not claim local empirical-field convergence for a general forbidden set.

Manifest integrity is 128/128. All 24 assigned dependency levels match the current graph.
